games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'abnormal' mean?
rounds.answer: Not normal or usual
rounds.explanation: The prefix ab- reverses normal, which is why Sami calls the twisted prints abnormal.

rounds.prompt: In a film script, what does CUT TO: tell the audience?
choices: The camera moves closer to the actor
The actor must whisper the next line
The scene is filmed from above
The film jumps to a new scene
rounds.answer: The film jumps to a new scene
rounds.explanation: CUT TO: marks a sudden change of scene, unlike ZOOM, which only changes the distance.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from “Nookwatch: The Forest Mission”, part 2. He will need ____ rest and a new capsule shelter closer to the main path.

rounds.answer: Kobi, the centre's oldest lemur, is missing from his sleeping nook.

rounds.prompt: In the film script version, which camera movement reveals the wooden Nookwatch sign?
choices: The character's name is written in capital letters and is followed by a colon.

rounds.answer: The camera pans slowly to the right until the wooden sign is revealed.
rounds.explanation: PAN is the slow horizontal sweep, so the sign appears gradually instead of in a sudden cut.

rounds.prompt: Amal says you cannot stay neutral once you have seen the animals up close. What does neutral mean here?

rounds.answer: Here neutral means refusing to take sides, which Amal now believes is impossible.
rounds.explanation: The surrounding words about feeling things as real and urgent give neutral its meaning here.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Which camera direction sweeps the view slowly across a scene?
rounds.answer: PAN
rounds.explanation: PAN is the slow horizontal sweep; ZOOM changes distance and CUT TO jumps to a new shot.

rounds.prompt: Amal says you cannot stay neutral once you have seen the animals. What does 'neutral' mean here?
rounds.answer: Refusing to take sides
rounds.explanation: Neutral means taking neither side, and Amal argues that seeing the animals makes that impossible.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence writes its compound noun correctly?
choices: I keep my tooth brush in the cup board.
She brought a first-aid kit to the camp.
The guide book showed the wild life reserve.
rounds.answer: She brought a first-aid kit to the camp.
rounds.explanation: First-aid is hyphenated, while toothbrush, cupboard, guidebook and wildlife are closed and bamboo forest is open.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'nook' mean?
choices: A small, cosy corner where you can hide
A refusal to believe something is true
A long, narrow cut or channel in a surface
A book of instructions for a machine
rounds.answer: A small, cosy corner where you can hide
rounds.explanation: A nook is a sheltered corner, which is why Kobi chose one as his sleeping place.

rounds.prompt: In “The Forest Guardians”, which punctuation mark follows each character's name?
rounds.answer: A colon
rounds.explanation: The colon separates the speaker from the words spoken, so speech marks are never needed.

rounds.prompt: Which of these compound nouns is written in the hyphenated form?
rounds.answer: close-up
rounds.explanation: Close-up always carries its hyphen; toothbrush and woodland are closed, and bus stop is open.
